title: skills(objectstack-platform): plugin-development.md still lists a `feature_flags` settings manifest with `ai_enabled` / `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*`; PR #30272 removes that namespace
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate ①: a shipped text that will say something wrong (`skills/**` ships to customer agents through `npx skills add`). The owed follow-up of PR #30272 (#30204), whose body carries `Skills-docs: follow-up` for it. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes it.

## Defect

`skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md:354`–`356` (read at `origin/main` `5fa9375e`): "**`feature_flags` settings manifest** (`@objectstack/service-settings`) — org-tunable toggles like `ai_enabled` / `beta_*`, resolvable at runtime and env-overridable via `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` (ADR-0007 settings cascade)."

PR #30272 removes the four `feature_flags` keys (none had a reader, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove), the then-empty namespace, its Setup entry and the `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` export. After it merges, `getManifest('feature_flags')` throws `UnknownNamespaceError`, and `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` env vars have no effect.

## Business reason

A customer's AI agent reads this reference to build a plugin. Told there is an org-tunable `feature_flags` namespace, it writes `ai_enabled` checks against a namespace that no longer exists, or tells an administrator to set `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED`, which does nothing.

## Acceptance

1. The bullet is removed, or replaced by the live answer: a plugin that needs an org toggle declares its own settings manifest; a capability a deployment advertises is `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` (the next bullet).
2. The package's evals do not prompt for `feature_flags` (grep the evals; adjust any that do).
3. Land after PR #30272 merges, so the text matches `main`.

## Reader who acts

`domain:skills` lane after triage. Tier H (governed surface `skills/**`): human merge.

## Dedup

Searched issues: `feature_flags plugin-development` (1 hit: #30204 itself). No skills card covers this bullet.
